* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Wuta, Endor, U
|strategy=By Shelby Abercrombie<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/wuta.html</ref>

This guy is one of my favorite Ewoks. He has all the Ewok bells and whistles. Cheap deploy, Ewok power and forfeit bonus, ability 2, and he is a scout to boot (not all Ewoks are!).

He can quite easily be power 3, ability 2 when roaming around [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] with [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] or an [[Ithorian]]. Once you add to that all the scout enhancers and Ewok enhancers scattered throughout the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] set, and this little fuzzy becomes quite attractive.

His special ability is a must in any [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] deck. Play multiple copies of [[Wuta]], and then you only need to play one copy each of the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] sites you need to generate force and drain with... since he can fetch them from your reserve Deck them for you each turn. I even suggest playing with 2 or 3 Wutas in a [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed{{!}}Rebel Strike Team]] deck, since he guarantees that you can get the sites you need to flip your objective. On top of that, he can be downloaded by everyone's favorite Wookie, [[Chewbacca]] of [[Kashyyyk]].

He is also quite a blessing in the new [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Booster Draft format. The ability to fetch all your sites is quite advantageous in such an environment since your choice can sometimes be quite limited and characters in good numbers are vital to survive against Imperials obvious blue and red power. [[Wuta]] can be the key to getting you good force generation, defining the forest layout, and minimising the zero destiny locations in your deck.

Combos: [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] allows you to fetch [[Wuta]], which provides you with enough ability to draw battle destiny (not to mention 7 or 8 power), and then [[Wuta]] can get you the site you need with two blue bars for your Ewok horde.

Drop [[Wuta]] 1st turn and start fetching your sites. If they try to jump him early, surprise them with two more Ewoks and an extra battle destiny.
|combos=* [[Wuta]] + [[Ewok Sentry]] x2 + [[Sound The Attack]] Deploy [[Wuta]] and start pulling your sites. If the Dark Side player comes down for him, surprise them with two more Ewoks and an extra battle destiny.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Wuta</ref>
